card.name: Small linking words in clinical definitions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as by, of, a, with, to and 'e.g.,' inside medical definitions and explanatory clauses. They often come right after a condition or finding like muscle contraction, pontine lesions or neuromuscular blockade.

modes.label: Definition glossary
modes.description: Linking words in a short glossary-style definition of a medical condition.
modes.example: An involuntary action in which the muscles contract; caused<< by>> a problem with the brain.
